biography: Martin Rich's journey began not on a grand circuit, but on the winding country roads of rural Oxfordshire. As a boy, he spent hours watching rally videos, dreaming of the day he could harness the raw power of an engine. His first taste of racing came unexpectedly at a local karting track, where he outperformed seasoned regulars despite driving a borrowed machine. This sparked a fierce determination. Lacking the deep pockets often required for motorsport, Martin worked tirelessly as a mechanic to fund his early racing. He climbed the ranks steadily, earning a reputation for reliability and race craft. A defining moment came in the British GT Cup, where a daring last-lap overtake secured him a podium finish, attracting the attention of Ligier. Now at the peak of his career, Martin pilots a Ligier JS2 R, striving to make his mark on the world of sportscar racing.
drivingStyle: Martin is a calculated and precise driver, known for his exceptional car control and tire management. He prioritizes consistency over outright aggression, preferring to build momentum throughout a race rather than risk early mistakes. His cornering technique is smooth and efficient, maximizing grip and minimizing wear. Under pressure, Martin remains remarkably composed, a trait that has earned him the respect of his rivals and the trust of his team. He is adept at reading track conditions and adapting his strategy accordingly.

rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle during the 2022 Ligier European Series season resulted in a controversial collision, creating lingering animosity.
Dubois, known for his aggressive driving style, often clashes with Martin's more measured approach, leading to tense moments and heated exchanges.
Both drivers are vying for the lead spot on the Ligier team, leading to a competitive atmosphere and a constant push to outperform each other.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother.
Listens to classical music to calm his nerves before each race.
Meticulously cleans his helmet visor before every session, regardless of how clean it already is.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about taking unnecessary risks; it's about making calculated decisions and executing them flawlessly.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2023 Ligier European Series race at Monza, Italy, after a strategic pit stop and flawless drive, marking his first major international victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2021 British GT Championship finale at Silverstone while leading, costing him the championship title.
